type_verdicts.why: The static is a handle to a crate::tls_hot::HotKey<AtomicI64>; every load/store resolves the calling thread's own slot (object/mod.rs), so no address is shared across threads.

perry-stdlib's link-time feature slot (common/feature_hooks.rs): an AtomicUsize holding only the bits of a plain `fn` pointer (set() asserts size_of::<F>() == usize and stores a code address; 0 = uninstalled). It never holds a heap or arena address, so thread exit cannot leave it dangling.
